policy: Native generated alpha required. New generations and precise reference edits only through built-in imagegen. Local processing limited to alpha-preserving resize/format conversion.
reviewPolicy: An accepted source has five digits, the correct equipment identity and native alpha. Geometry and real equip checks do not by themselves constitute final visual fit approval. Retired six-finger references must never be reused.
wearTest: prototype/wardrobe-trigger-hands.browser.test.cjs: 10 hand styles x 2 firearms x 2 sexes = 40 real equip, firearm-to-blade pose switch, unequip-restore and dual-contact checks. Grouped visual review separately recorded.

visualReview.scope: All 10 final grouped sheets personally inspected: bare, nanoWeaveGloves, servoGauntlet, hands_general_1, hands_general_2, hands_general_3, hands_general_4, hands_general_5, workGloves and hands_specialist_5; each sheet contains male and female actual equip renders with pistol and rifle (40 portraits total).
visualReview.result: No visible floating handle or disconnected wrist found in this representative firearm fit matrix. Independent trigger index, palm/handle contact, muzzle direction, hand scale and long-bracer seams reviewed. Final five-digit source anatomy also independently reviewed by fit_audit and root.
visualReview.limits: This is the 40-case firearm subset, not final approval of every weapon, armor combination or gameplay interaction. Broader final QA is recorded separately. Contact alpha is diagnostic only: an antialiased fingertip edge or a valid grip channel must not be moved just to maximize pixel alpha.

finalGunCloseups.result: All twenty final 600x440 closeups inspected individually using the corrected five-digit bare hand. Handle is enclosed by thumb and three curled fingers; separate index enters the trigger-guard region; wrist meets sleeve; barrel points out/down. No source or contact-coordinate change required.
